description: This file contains an abstract class 'AbstractThingEventStrategy' that implements the 'EventStrategy' interface. It provides common functionality for handling 'ThingEvent' objects related to 'Thing' entities, including merging metadata and applying events to build updated 'Thing' instances. The class is intended to be subclassed for specific event handling strategies within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: AbstractThingEventStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class providing common logic for handling 'ThingEvent' objects, merging metadata, and building updated 'Thing' instances. Designed to be extended for specific event handling implementations.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles a 'ThingEvent' and updates a 'Thing' with a new revision and timestamp; returns null if 'thing' is null.

methods.name: mergeMetadata
methods.description: Merges metadata from the event into the 'Thing', considering resource path and presence of metadata.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Hook method intended to be overridden by subclasses to apply custom event logic to the 'ThingBuilder'; by default, returns the builder unchanged.
